user.title: Snapmaker U1
user.description: Enter the address of the printer's Moonraker. The integration checks that the printer publishes print_task_config, which is the U1 multicolor state.

data_description.api_key: Only needed when the printer's Moonraker does not trust this client's address.
data_description.use_ssl: Only when Moonraker sits behind an HTTPS proxy.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Moonraker at that address.
error.klippy_not_ready: Moonraker answered but Klipper is not ready. Start the printer, then try again.
error.not_u1: That printer does not publish print_task_config, so it is not a Snapmaker U1.

abort.already_configured: This printer is already set up.

end_led_turn_off.name: Turn off LED at the end

set_color_map.name: Set color map
set_color_map.description: Map a logical color onto a physical head. The printer refuses this while it is printing or paused.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Which printer to write to. Only needed when more than one is set up.

logical.name: Logical color
logical.description: Color index 0 to 31, the number a sliced file uses.

head.name: Head
head.description: Physical head 0 to 3 that should print that color.

set_filament.name: Set filament
set_filament.description: Write a filament identity into one slot by hand. This clears the slot's official flag and its SKU, because the identity is no longer the one from the tag.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Which printer to write to. Only needed when more than one is set up.

filament_type.name: Filament type
filament_type.description: Material, for example PLA or PETG.

sub_type.name: Sub type
sub_type.description: Variant, for example Basic, Matte, Silk or HF.

color.name: Color
color.description: RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA hex. A leading # is fine.

force.name: Force
force.description: Needed to overwrite a slot that holds an official spool.

send_gcode.name: Send G-code
send_gcode.description: Run one G-code command on the printer.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Which printer to write to. Only needed when more than one is set up.
